trailhead.label: Soraga di Fassa (Piaz Bepo Roch), the APT’s start

waypoints.label: Drinking fountain, the last before the climb

cautions: A steep, sustained climb of about 340 m in 2.3 km; the APT suggests care on the descent, which can be slippery in the shade.
The forest road runs along the top of a steep red sandstone gorge: keep your dog close at the edge.
About 1.6 km on tarmac, village lanes in Soraga open to cars.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
